title: SMERSH
body: SMERSH was a Soviet counter-intelligence agency. Its Russian name is an abbreviation of a phrase meaning death to spies.

title: Bangladesh cricket team
body: Bangladesh became the tenth nation to receive Test cricket status in 2000.

title: V-2 rocket
body: The first human-made object to enter outer space was a V-2 rocket powered by a liquid-propellant rocket engine.
